audit.whatIsWrong: Zaahen's W is absent from the entire matchup, and his R is called 'Final Retribution' while the missing-interactions data for this exact pairing names it Grim Deliverance.
audit.why: The W stabs in a direction at 850 range and then pulls everyone hit toward him — against a champion whose whole plan is spacing, a 12-14s ranged pull is the single most important thing on his bar, and it was never mentioned. The R also heals for a portion of the damage dealt, which the page never says.
audit.corrected: W added to phases[3].why, mid and dontsFull[1].d; the R renamed to Grim Deliverance in mid and wants.foe[2] and its heal stated.
sources: missingInteractions headlines naming 'Dreaded Return (W)' and 'Grim Deliverance (R)'

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 1 reads Vayne while the packet chart says Skill and whys[1] says 'Level 2 stays neutral'; row 3 reads Skill while the packet says Zaahen and whys[3] says 'At 4-5 he claws ahead'.
audit.why: Both rows contradicted the packet chart and the explanation printed beside them, at a 48.67% win rate over 1576 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 3 aligned to the packet chart in both layers, row 3's rating lowered to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why and phases[3].why were generic boilerplate keyed to 'Ultimate' — the literal placeholder used throughout this matchup — and named no cooldown or spike.
audit.why: The 4-5 dip is his Q on 10s with a heal attached and the 850-range W pull, not his ultimate, which does not exist until 6.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten with the real cooldowns and the anti-heal requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d were placeholder text with no numbers, and the auto-attack reset that opens his combo was never stated.
audit.why: Q is flagged autoReset and knocks up on recast, E is a 10s dash, R is 110s at rank 1 and heals. The reset means the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the cooldowns, the reset tell and the pull.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Zaahen's Ultimate is down.
edits.after: Neither pattern is assembled yet — his Q is 10s and your Silver Bolts need three hits. Farm it out.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Q is 10s and heals him, and W pulls you in from 850 units. Give ground and buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: At 4-5 he claws ahead because Q Darkin Glaive poke and E Golden Onslaught burst are brutal against your thin health pool - respect the range and hold Condemn. Level 6 is a skill line: his R Final Retribution all-in beats you only when Condemn is down and no wall is near, so choose where you fight and the flip is yours.
edits.after: At 4-5 he claws ahead: his Q is a 10s auto-reset that heals him, and his W stabs 850 units out then pulls you in - respect that range and hold Condemn. Level 6 is a skill line: his R Grim Deliverance heals off the damage it deals and beats you only when Condemn is down and no wall is near, so choose where you fight and the flip is yours.

edits.before: R Final Retribution locking you before you roll
edits.after: R Grim Deliverance landing before you can roll

edits.before: His big cooldown. Condemn/kite its engage. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His R is 110s at rank 1 and heals off the damage — commit after he spends it.

edits.before: Zaahen wastes Ultimate — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His E dash is 10s — Tumble sideways as he lands, not backwards.

edits.before: That is Zaahen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His combo opens on an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His W pulls you in from 850 units — never stand in a straight line.

notes: The packet has enemyAbilities: null for Zaahen and the kit file carries no ability names, so the only naming evidence available was the missing-interactions headlines for this exact pairing, which give 'The Darkin Glaive (Q)', 'Dreaded Return (W)' and 'Grim Deliverance (R)'. I renamed the R on that basis. I did NOT touch 'E Golden Onslaught' — no source in the brief either confirms or refutes it. Zaahen's passive lets him revive when filled with Determination; that is in Riot's text but nowhere on the page, and I did not write it because I cannot state the condition precisely enough to be actionable.
